car_colusa_rice.crop_note: 2025 CDL crop assumed again in 2026 (2026 CDL not published)

source.title: Median length of the longest bare run, winters with the current crop

median_days.note: 6 winters of 6 with Rice had a run of >= 14 consecutive satellite-class 'bare' days between 1 Oct and 30 Apr (calendar.json classes, rule detector); median of start/end offsets from 1 Oct

bare_window.method: Longest consecutive run of class 'bare' in backend/field calendar.json, 1 Oct to 30 Apr, for winters following a year whose CDL crop equals the current crop (2016-2024 starts; CDL 2025 crop assumed again for 2026).

source.title: Share of 1981-2024 winters with at least one >= 25 mm day in the window (mean of 3 NOAA stations)
Conditional climatology weighted by CPC category probabilities

chance_given_cpc_outlook.note: Outlook, not a forecast. value = sum over terciles of CPC probability x historical event rate in that tercile; low/high = range of climatology, blended, and favoured-category-only.

heavy_rain_in_window.method: Terciles of FMA station precipitation totals (1991-2020 base) classify each winter 1981-2024 as below/near/above. Event = any day >= 25 mm inside the window dates. CPC weights: favoured category gets CPC's probability; near-normal 33.3%; the opposite category the remainder (the CPC convention for small tilts; our assumption). About 13 winters per tercile: noisy. Station gauges, not POWER (POWER rain runs ~50-70% wet).

scenario.method: CPC-weighted conditional climatology: for each non-overlapping outlook season (temperature NDJ, FMA, MJJ, ASO; precipitation NDJ, FMA) the shift = sum of CPC probability x (tercile mean - all-year mean) at the 3 NOAA stations, averaged. Temperature shift = mean of the 4 seasons (applied all year). Precip shift = NDJ+FMA mm change / mean water-year total (other months unchanged). Range: climatology (0, 0) to the favoured category fully realised. Outlook scenario, not a forecast.
